# Golden world plans

The canonical plans (`world::writePlan`) of fresh rooms that `tests/unit/world/test_world_generation.cpp` generates and
compares byte for byte (I3 step 3, ADR-0010 §8), in Debug and Release alike:
`plan-<titles>-seed-<world seed>.json` for 0, 1, 15, 50, 56 (`D + B`, all face-out), 57 (the first spine-out title),
890 (the reference library's size) and 2,000 (the stress fixture's) titles, each with the world seeds 102938, 7 and
18446744073709551615, and 8,000 titles with 102938 (the room grown to 16 m, 2,385 titles unplaced for capacity).

`update-*.json` are the plans after incremental updates (I3 step 9, ADR-0010 §10) that
`tests/unit/world/test_world_update.cpp` makes and compares the same way: `update-50-plus-10-seed-102938.json` (G10: 10
titles added to G02's 50, all face-out before, the 10 spine-out), `update-890-plus-5-minus-3-seed-102938.json` (5 titles
arrive and 3 leave the catalog, their slots kept) and `update-3205-full-plus-20-seed-102938.json` (the base room's
side-wall modules full, their reserve and dressed levels taken, then 20 titles that grow the room by a step).

Since I4 step 1 the plans are buildings in schema 2 (ADR-0013 §5): the room above on the floor `gen4` at the north
row's first position, the ground floor, generator 1.3; their rooms' contents are the frozen schema-1 oracles' of
`../v1/` (the lift's test checks it). `building-5-systems-seed-102938.json` is the building that
`tests/unit/world/test_world_building_plan.cpp` generates from five systems on four floors (snes and megadrive on
`gen4`, a fifth-generation console, a handheld and a computer of the test's own table, their rooms standing as the SNES
room does).

`building-esde-seed-102938.json` (I4 step 3) is the building that `tests/unit/world/test_floor_scene.cpp` generates from
the building fixture's systems (`tests/fixtures/esde/building`: amiga, gb, mame, the custom pocketlab classified by gb's
platform tag, pokemini, psx and snes, with the shipped `systems.json`, families and templates; synthetic selections of
the fixture's title counts) on five floors, whose floors' scenes are `../scene/building-esde-seed-102938.*`: since I4
step 4 three console rooms (gb, psx, snes), the arcade room (mame), the handheld floor's shared room (pocketlab,
pokemini) and the computer floor's (amiga's 20 titles, under the threshold of 30).

Since I4 step 4 the configuration's canonical form holds `sharedRoomMinTitles` and a selection its `distinctTitles`:
every plan's `inputDigest` line moved once, nothing else. The I3 room suites generate with `sharedRoomMinTitles` 0
(`world_generation_support.hpp`'s `roomConfig()`), so that a room of any size stays a console room.

The selections are generated by `tests/unit/world/world_generation_support.hpp` (`makeSelection`, selection seed
20261018): invented titles made of syllables, deterministic favourites, play counts and ratings, and `titles / 20`
unplaced games. Nothing here comes from a real library: the plans hold GameIds and the world's ids only.

The files are rewritten only on purpose, when a change of the generator, the template, the prefabs or the selection
generator alters the plans: run the test with `RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1`
(`$env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN = '1'; build/msvc-x64-debug/bin/rv_tests.exe "world/generation: golden*"`, and
`"world/update: golden*,world/update: priorities*"` for the update sequences), review the
difference, and say in the commit why the plans moved. A change that places any game differently is a new generator
major version (`world::kGeneratorVersion`, ADR-0010 §10).
